# achu

> achu is a free, open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux that beautifies screenshots, stores them in a local gallery, redacts secrets on-device, extracts text via OCR, and drafts GitHub bug reports with AI — all without uploading your images unless you choose to.

achu (அச்சு) means "print" or "mold" in Tamil. Official site: https://achu.app

## What achu does

achu turns raw screenshots into polished, share-ready visuals. It runs locally as an Electron desktop application. Your captures stay on your machine unless you explicitly export, copy, or push a GitHub issue.

## Key features

- Canvas beautification: padding, rounded corners, shadows, mesh gradients, browser chrome mockups, aspect-ratio presets
- Local Screenshot Gallery: save beautified PNG/JPEG/WebP to a folder (default `~/achu-screenshots`), browse thumbnails, reopen in editor, copy to clipboard, soft-delete to `.achu-trash` (auto-purged after 30 days), custom folder in Settings
- Smart Privacy Guard: on-device OCR scans for API keys, passwords, emails, IPs; one-click blur or solid redaction
- AI Issue Agent: vision models draft structured GitHub issues; supports Ollama (local), Gemini, OpenAI, Claude
- OCR text grabber: right-click canvas to extract and copy text locally via Tesseract WASM
- Rich annotations: shapes, arrows, text, pen, emoji; undo/redo history

## Frequently asked questions

### What is achu?
achu is a lightweight screenshot beautifier and workflow tool for developers and QA teams. It frames screenshots, annotates them, stores them in a local gallery, redacts sensitive data, and can generate GitHub bug reports from images.

### Does achu upload my screenshots to the cloud?
No. Beautification, gallery storage, privacy scanning, and OCR run locally. External APIs are only used if you configure the AI Issue Agent with a cloud provider — and only for the issue text you approve.

### What is the achu screenshot gallery?
A built-in local library. Save from the footer "Gallery" button, open via the toolbar grid icon, browse thumbnails, double-click to reopen in the editor. Files are stored on disk in a folder you choose (default `~/achu-screenshots`).

### What happens when I delete an image from the gallery?
Deletes are soft-deletes: files move to a `.achu-trash` subfolder inside your gallery directory and are automatically removed after 30 days.

### Which AI providers does achu support?
Ollama (fully local), Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude for the Issue Agent vision workflow.

### Is achu open source?
Yes. MIT License. Source: https://github.com/QAInsights/achu
